# Bohdan Moroz

> Software engineer working in applied AI. Four years building production web and mobile apps for US logistics, HR, and fintech teams. Based in Sofia, Bulgaria. Open to freelance work.

Bohdan Moroz is a full-stack TypeScript engineer specializing in agentic AI workflows and end-to-end delivery. He works remotely with US small and mid-size businesses, primarily in logistics (TMS), HR onboarding, and fintech. He ships across the stack: React and Next.js on the web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS on the server, with CI/CD, Docker, and self-hosted infrastructure as defaults. Where AI workloads can't ship traffic to OpenAI or Anthropic, he runs self-hosted models via Ollama, vLLM, and LiteLLM.

He is currently available for freelance engagements. The fastest way to reach him is email: contact@bohdanmoroz.com.

## Stack

- Languages: TypeScript across the stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue / Nuxt (legacy)
- Mobile: React Native, Expo
- Backend: NestJS, microservices
- AI / LLMs: Claude and Codex coding agents; self-hosted inference via Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM
- Infrastructure: CI/CD, Docker, self-hosted on personal infra, AWS, Vercel, Hetzner

## Selected work

- [ClaraHR](https://clarahr.io): Onboarding system for US truck drivers — a chat bot collects info and registers them in the carrier's system. NestJS microservices, Next.js portal, Vite admin panel, full CI/CD. Lead developer. 8 carriers, 635 drivers onboarded. 2025 → present.
- [CargoHub](https://map.cargoetl.com): Public freight marketplace where US shippers and brokers browse carriers' trucks, post loads, and book capacity. Live tracking and document flow built in; in-product AI assistant handles routine booking and dispatch. Sole developer. Next.js, TypeScript. 9 carriers, ~2,500 trucks. 2026 → present.
- CargoFinance: Accounting and light-fintech tooling for a logistics back-office — invoicing, transfer tracking, payouts. Sole developer. Next.js, TypeScript. 2026 → present.
- [CargoETL](https://cargoetl.com): Closed TMS platform for US logistics carriers and dispatchers. Built and maintained the Next.js dispatcher dashboard and the React Native (Expo) driver app — order flow, live tracking, document handling, dispatch comms. 2024 → present.
- [Altek TMS](https://altek.digital): Earlier TMS for US logistics carriers and dispatchers — Vue / Nuxt dispatcher dashboard and React Native driver app. First multi-year production project; service has since wound down. 2022 → 2024.

## How he works

- End-to-end ownership: takes a feature from a half-formed Figma or paragraph of requirements through frontend, backend, infrastructure, and deploy without handoffs.
- TypeScript across the stack with CI/CD and Docker by default; self-host when it makes sense, AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.
- Agentic AI is part of the workflow — Claude and Codex agents handle the typing while he drives architecture, review, and integration. Meaningfully more shipped per week than a hands-on-keyboard pace.
- Async-friendly, used to working with US clients from Sofia (UTC+2). Most of his career has been remote across time zones.
